Community Crowdfunding System

Direct impact on Monero development

Monero utilizes a community crowdfunding system where projects are proposed for development and funded by the community. Funding is held in escrow and remunerated to developers once programming milestones are achieved. Anyone may generate new proposals or fund existing ones.
